evidence:
Reviewed only solution_covers_every_deliverable, against the actual frozen workbook Quality Checks row 18 / quality number 17 and matching Internal Quality Checks row (no additional annotation). No asked-for screen, role or product flow lacks an implementation. In the path citations below, task/ is relative to .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/.

The local/no-account workspace and ready-on-opening flow in instruction.md and overview.md are implemented by task/solution/app/src/app.tsx:7,53-60,142-169: five supplied example choices, automatic startup execution, editor/preview/console, title/filename fields, New, Save and saved-record loading. Language is derived from the filename at runtime.ts:23 and 299-347; JavaScript receives a fresh document, HTML is parsed into a complete preview and CSS styles the built-in document. App.tsx:16-18,42,127-138,149,166 implements expandable values, retained console history with levels, clear, durations, syntax/line-number editing, and a resettable/cancellable automatic-run timer. App.tsx:133,147 and style.css:1,3 implement workspace themes, labelled keyboard controls/focus, and stacking below 850px.

The lifecycle and error requirements in behaviour.md/security.md have implementation at runtime.ts:24-67 (source guards), 69-149,200-252 (line attribution, error/Promise capture and timer tracking), 263-269 (completed-preview interactions), and 350-388 (current-frame token/source checks, cancellation, deadline watchdog and rollback to the latest successful snapshot). CSP and sandbox isolation are at runtime.ts:4,209-213,344-346,359,370; dynamic import is explicitly refused at 41-43. These are implemented product paths, not an assertion based on control labels.

Shared durable save/create/update/load, title normalization and case-sensitive uniqueness, exact source storage, and optimistic revisions are implemented in server.js:41-88,113-128; frontend draft retention and reload/reapply are at app.tsx:62-73,95-103,154-158. The server honors DB_PATH at server.js:8, serves the root/health at 12,100-102 and binds 0.0.0.0 at 113; solve.sh copies ordinary shipped app files. No authentication is required by this brief.

Current measured product evidence was checked, not treated as an Oracle score: raw-evidence-index.json SHA256 d3c56b90b8608c10e885e29e95d62cf39f79a8c09fd65038ad9a09e5cb7313f0 listed 102 current_golden artifacts, all of whose current hashes matched. RESULTS.json SHA256 c7e553fb3c51a25f29e60ef1d417f3471547c0b37e4b1887d4c2f8eeee97050d records 22 actual_app_files; all match the frozen app bytes. Its 74 requested fact keys have no missing/failed keys and no reused fact keys. Inspected actual observations include S01 automatic startup, S15 nested object/array inspection, S03 interaction after 6.1 seconds and completed Stop preserving the typed input, S04 pending rollback, S09 finite positive controls followed by bounded 4.9-second loop failures, S11 HTML error at complete-document line 6, S13 JS/HTML Promise rejection lines, S17 repeated edits with no intermediate execution, S22 PID 16 to 347 restart and exact records/example inventory, and S23 two opposite stale-save cycles with 409 refusal, preserved drafts and successful revisions 3/5 after reapplication. Surface evidence records pointer-free example/library navigation, visible focus, all primary controls reachable, and a 390x844 edit/run/preview/clear flow. I viewed the desktop and mobile captures and confirmed the requested three-pane surfaces are present.

Adversarial comparison: a localStorage-only library or a last-write-wins save could appear complete in a screenshot, but is excluded here by the SQLite implementation plus independent-context readback/restart and both stale-save observations. A conforming alternative may choose a different editor/library layout, CSS sample, labels, frontend framework or default theme; none is treated as a missing deliverable in this review. These were source/evidence comparisons, not newly executed mutant apps. Full configured judge completion/workload, Oracle, target-model and empirical reward ordering remain unmeasured as the index states; this Pass establishes only this workbook row's plausible reference coverage and the cited scripted product observations.
